items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: Like a Art Blakey style band.

ctx.x: Yeah. Like a Art Blakey style band. And they came in second. And then Dizzy played. And I’d never heard Dizzy on record, and being a trumpet player, I mean I am sure that my hair literally stood on end when he started playing for the first time. And I of course immediately raced out and bought everything. And then it was Miles and all the saxophone players and so the music I was listening to when I entered as a listener were the people that were hot at the time. Miles, Cannonball, Wes Montgomery, Wynton Kelly,…
Yeah. I guess that’s usually the way it happens.
